description: This Java class implements a file filter for use with JFileChooser, allowing filtering of files based on specified extensions and providing descriptive text about the filter.

classes.name: GenericFileFilter
classes.description: A customizable file filter for use with file chooser dialogs, supporting extension-based filtering and description customization.

methods.name: GenericFileFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with a description and multiple extensions.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Determines if a file should be accepted based on whether it matches the filter criteria or is a directory.

methods.name: getExtension
methods.description: Extracts the extension from a given file filename.

methods.name: addExtension
methods.description: Adds an extension to the filter and invalidates the description cache.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the filter, optionally including the list of extensions.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description text for the filter.

methods.name: setExtensionListInDescription
methods.description: Configures whether to include the extensions list in the description text.

methods.name: isExtensionListInDescription
methods.description: Checks if the extensions list is included in the description.
